examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}い{夜|よる}に{薪|まき}を{焚|た}いて{暖|あたた}まった。
examples.english: On a cold night, I burned firewood to warm up.

notes:
{焚|た}く means to burn or kindle something intentionally, such as fires, incense, or leaves.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: {火|ひ}を{焚|た}く

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {焚|た}き{火|び}を{焚|た}く: to build a bonfire
- お{香|こう}を{焚|た}く: to burn incense
- {落|お}ち{葉|ば}を{焚|た}く: to burn fallen leaves
- {薪|まき}を{焚|た}く: to burn firewood

DISTINCTION FROM {炊|た}く:
- {焚|た}く: to burn (fire, incense) - uses {焚|た} kanji
- {炊|た}く: to cook rice - uses {炊|た} kanji

Both are pronounced たく but have different meanings and kanji.
